app.title: Zero Mail
app.description: Reach inbox zero without giving up control.

landing.heading: Zero Mail
landing.tagline: AI triage for Gmail that labels, archives, and drafts with rules you can audit before anything is sent.

how.title: Three steps to an inbox that handles itself
how.desc: Connect Gmail, write rules in plain English, review what happened. That's the loop.

step1.title: Connect Gmail
step1.desc: One-click Google sign-in with the minimum scopes Zero Mail needs to triage your inbox.

step2.title: Write rules in plain English
step2.desc: "Archive Stripe receipts and label them Finance." That's it. We turn it into structured triage.
step2.example: Archive Stripe receipts and label them Finance

step3.title: Review what triage did
step3.desc: Every action is logged with reason and rule. Undo anything in one click.

f1.title: Plain-English rules
f1.desc: Write triage logic the way you'd describe it to a teammate. We compile it into structured matchers.

f2.title: BYOK ready
f2.desc: Use OpenRouter routing or plug in your own OpenAI / Anthropic key. Your wallet, your keys.

f3.title: Auditable trail
f3.desc: Every automated label, archive, or draft is logged with the rule that fired and the message it touched.

f4.title: Vietnamese-first
f4.desc: Native VI / EN bilingual UI. Write rules in either language; we triage either way.

f5.title: No auto-send
f5.desc: Zero Mail labels, archives, and saves drafts. It will never send a message without your review.

f6.title: Revoke any time
f6.desc: Disconnect Gmail or delete your account from Settings. Tokens deleted immediately.

trust.title: Built around what your inbox actually deserves

c1.title: No long-term storage of email content
c1.body: Bodies sanitized, truncated, sent to the LLM, then dropped. No embeddings, no prompts, no completions retained.

c2.title: No auto-send — ever
c2.body: Zero Mail labels, archives, and saves drafts. You always review before anything ships.

c3.title: Revoke any time
c3.body: Disconnect Gmail or delete your account from Settings. We delete tokens and selections immediately.

c4.title: Auditable triage trail
c4.body: Every automated action is logged with the rule that fired and the message it touched.

p1.title: We never store your email content
p1.body: Bodies are sanitized, sent to the LLM in a single request, and discarded. No prompts or replies are kept long-term.

p2.title: Auto-send is off by default — and stays off
p2.body: Zero Mail can label, archive, and save drafts. It will never send a message without your review. This is a product invariant, not a setting.

p3.title: Bring your own key — your wallet, your keys
p3.body: Use OpenRouter routing or plug in your own OpenAI / Anthropic key. BYOK requests bypass our LLM cost entirely.

login.title: Sign in
login.headline: Reach inbox zero without giving up control.
login.body: Zero Mail connects to Gmail so you can set safe, reviewable automation rules. This phase only stores your account, connection, and onboarding choices.

gmail_scope_required.body: Sign in worked, but Gmail access wasn't granted. Click Sign in with Google and approve the Gmail permission to continue.

connect.heading: Connect Gmail to finish setup
connect.body: Zero Mail needs a Gmail grant before later phases can watch, label, archive, or draft. You can revoke access anytime.

template.heading: Choose a starter template
template.body: A starter template helps Zero Mail understand how you want your inbox handled. You can change it later in Settings.

completion.heading: You're ready. Open Settings to review your choices.

gmailConnection.heading: Gmail connection
